Preparing the walkthrough

1 of 3
Walk through every room

Tap a room — Foyer, Living, Kitchen, each bedroom — and the camera flies you there at eye level. Guided tour plays through them in order.

2 of 3
Look around and walk

Use W A S D or the on-screen joystick. Drag to look. On a phone, pinch or use the +/− buttons to zoom the dollhouse.

3 of 3
Change the finishes

Open Your preferences for style, flooring, wall colour and kitchen. Switch Morning, Golden hour or Night from the sun button.
